1 import SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedronNine
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralRemotePairs
3 
4 /-! The remaining octahedron geometry is confined to the local pairs, opposite petals, and finite cuts. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
7 
8 open OctahedralTriangles
9 
10 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {graph : P.SixVertexGraph}
11 variable {small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
12   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4} {source : Fin 6} {slit : Fin 4}
13 variable (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit)
14 
15 /-- The two closed remote petals miss the corresponding closed finite slit segments. -/
16 structure FiniteCutsClear : Prop where
17   last : Disjoint (net.placedTriangle (true, 1)) (segment ℝ 0 (graph.openingPoint (opposite source) slit 4))
18   first : Disjoint (net.placedTriangle (true, 2)) (segment ℝ 0 (graph.openingPoint (opposite source) slit 0))
19 
20 /-- The local slit lemma supplies these three nonoverlap conclusions. -/
21 structure LocalPairs : Prop where
22   petals : net.Separated (true, 0) (true, 3)
23   left : net.Separated (true, 0) (false, 3)
24   right : net.Separated (true, 3) (false, 0)
25 
26 /-- The two opposite-petal comparisons, for this same development. -/
27 structure OppositePetals : Prop where
28   even : net.Separated (true, 0) (true, 2)
29   odd : net.Separated (true, 1) (true, 3)
30 
31 /-- The boundary argument discharges all four remote pairs from these three geometric inputs. -/
32 theorem remainingNine_of_core (local_pairs : net.LocalPairs) (opposite_pairs : net.OppositePetals)
33     (cuts : net.FiniteCutsClear) : net.RemainingNine where
34   slit_petals := local_pairs.petals
35   slit_left := local_pairs.left
36   slit_right := local_pairs.right
37   opposite_even := opposite_pairs.even
38   opposite_odd := opposite_pairs.odd
39   remote := by
40     intro i
41     fin_cases i
42     · exact net.remote_zero local_pairs.left opposite_pairs.even
43     · exact net.remote_one cuts.last opposite_pairs.odd
44     · exact net.remote_two cuts.first opposite_pairs.even
45     · exact net.remote_three local_pairs.right opposite_pairs.odd
46 
47 /-- Finishing the three remaining geometric lemmas yields the unchanged original-edge unfolding predicate. -/
48 theorem hasEdgeUnfolding_of_core (octahedral : graph.kind = .octahedron)
49     (local_pairs : net.LocalPairs) (opposite_pairs : net.OppositePetals) (cuts : net.FiniteCutsClear) :
50     P.HasEdgeUnfolding :=
51   net.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_nine_comparisons octahedral (net.remainingNine_of_core local_pairs opposite_pairs cuts)
52 
53 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
